evals.prompt:
У меня аддон для Garry's Mod, HUD просаживает FPS у игроков. Вот код lua/autorun/client/cl_myhud.lua:

```lua
hook.Add("HUDPaint", "MyHUD", function()
    surface.CreateFont("MyHudFont", {font = "Roboto", size = 24, weight = 500})

    local ply = LocalPlayer()
    if not IsValid(ply) then return end

    local w, h = ScrW(), ScrH()
    local hp = ply:Health()
    local money = ply:GetNWInt("money", 0)

    draw.RoundedBox(6, w / 2 - 150, h - 80, 300, 60, Color(20, 20, 20, 220))
    draw.SimpleText("HP: " .. hp, "MyHudFont", w / 2 - 130, h - 65, Color(255, 80, 80))
    draw.SimpleText("$" .. string.Comma(money), "MyHudFont", w / 2 - 130, h - 40, Color(120, 255, 120))

    local mat = Material("icon16/heart.png")
    surface.SetMaterial(mat)
    surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 255)
    surface.DrawTexturedRect(w / 2 - 145, h - 68, 16, 16)

    for _, medic in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("npc_medic_station")) do
        local scrPos = medic:GetPos():ToScreen()
        draw.SimpleText("МЕДПУНКТ", "MyHudFont", scrPos.x, scrPos.y, Color(255, 255, 255))
    end
end)
```

Найди все проблемы производительности и перепиши файл оптимально. Сохрани исправленный вариант в cl_myhud_fixed.lua и коротко перечисли, что было не так.
evals.expected_output: Fixed Lua file: font/colors/material created once outside hook, ScrW/ScrH cached with OnScreenSizeChanged, ents.FindByClass cached via timer/interval, strings rebuilt only on change
assertions: surface.CreateFont is called once at file load, not inside HUDPaint
No Color() constructor calls inside the per-frame HUDPaint function (colors precreated as upvalues)
Material() is cached outside the render hook
ScrW()/ScrH() results are cached outside the hook (with OnScreenSizeChanged recalc, or at minimum not recomputed as layout constants every frame)
ents.FindByClass is not called every frame (cached via timer or time-throttled)
Text strings (HP/money) are rebuilt only when the value changes, not every frame
findings.md correctly names per-frame allocation / GC pressure as a problem category

evals.prompt: Пишу магазин для DarkRP сервера в Garry's Mod. Нужен серверный обработчик покупки: клиент отправляет net-сообщение "MyShop_Buy" с ID предмета (строка) и количеством. Предметы лежат в общей таблице MYSHOP_ITEMS = { ["medkit"] = {price = 150, class = "item_healthkit"}, ["armor"] = {price = 300, class = "item_battery"} }. Деньги через ply:getDarkRPVar("money") / ply:addMoney(). Напиши серверный файл sv_shop.lua с обработчиком. Учти, что на сервер могут зайти читеры.
evals.expected_output: net.Receive with full validation: item id whitelisted against MYSHOP_ITEMS, amount bounded integer, money check server-side, rate limiting, no client-trusted price
assertions: Item ID is validated against MYSHOP_ITEMS whitelist (unknown IDs rejected)
Amount is validated as a bounded positive integer (rejects 0, negative, huge, fractional)
Price is computed server-side from MYSHOP_ITEMS (client never sends or influences price)
Money check (getDarkRPVar) happens before addMoney deduction
Rate limiting / cooldown on the net message per player is present

evals.prompt: Garry's Mod, нужен клиентский эффект: когда игрок получает урон, экран заливается красным и плавно гаснет за 2 секунды. Сервер уже шлёт net-сообщение "PlayerHurtFX" при уроне (util.AddNetworkString есть). Напиши клиентский файл cl_hurtfx.lua. Важно: у нас на сервере 80 игроков и куча аддонов, эффект не должен отъедать FPS, когда он неактивен (а это 99% времени).
evals.expected_output: HUDPaint hook registered only while effect active (hook.Add on net receive, hook.Remove when faded out), no per-frame allocations, correct client realm
assertions: HUDPaint hook is registered only while the effect is active: hook.Add in net.Receive, hook.Remove when faded out (not a permanently-registered hook with an early-return guard)
No Color() or other allocations inside the per-frame paint function (color precreated, alpha field mutated)
Fade uses frame-time-based math (FrameTime/CurTime/RealTime) so it lasts ~2 seconds regardless of FPS
Code is client-realm correct (net.Receive on client, no server-only calls)
